name: Publish Artifact
description: Publish something the agent produced into the Front of House conversation, where it renders as a card the user can see: an image (screenshot, chart, diagram) or a static HTML page (a single file, or a directory of index.html plus its css/js/image siblings). harnesst copies the files out of the agent's home directory and serves them back behind the user's own sign-in — pages inside a sandboxed preview panel.
